review.means: a review record that passes: no blocking finding, or the orchestrator's acceptance of its set-asides, unless the check plan excuses it

e2e.means: passed, waived by the operator or not applicable, unless the check plan or an exemption excuses it

norms.means: passed or waived where the check plan requires it; a failed run at the head blocks anyway

ci.means: the required status check of the default branch, green

voids: a head whose own diff differs
